resources.string: • \%color=#00FF00\%Anomaly:\%/color\% When the game starts, random tweaks are added to the existing pool. Each one added halves the chance for the next one, but one tweak is always guaranteed. Some tweaks are mutually exclusive.\%nl\%• \%color=#BC095D\%Brutal Crew:\%/color\% Crewmates will not get punished for e.g. executing other crew members as Sheriff.\%nl\%• \%color=#BC5322\%Chat Whispers:\%/color\% Players are able to whisper each other, privately exchanging information. Everyone will see you whispering.\%nl\%• \%color=#001ABC\%Compliant Killers:\%/color\% Neutral Killers work together in a team with their goal of being the last people standing.\%nl\%• \%color=#FFFB85\%Divine Intervention:\%/color\% Each round a random room selected becomes Protected, preventing anyone from attacking in this place.\%nl\%• \%color=#F03AFF\%Don't Fear The Reaper:\%/color\% Players can once use their random role ability after death.\%nl\%• \%color=#FFC725\%Election:\%/color\% During the first meeting, players have 20s to elect a Sovereign. The winner of this voting permanently gains bonus votes based on how many people elected him.\%nl\%• \%color=#7A5835\%Graveyard:\%/color\% When someone dies, their role is revealed to everyone.\%nl\%• \%color=#46FF92\%Haunted House:\%/color\% Everyone is able to see dead players move around.\%nl\%• \%color=#FF1919\%Impostoromicon:\%/color\% Impostors are not able to kill normally anymore. Instead, they vote on who's gonna get the Impostoromicon and gain the ability to kill. Other impostors can only use their side abilities.\%nl\%• \%color=#8519FF\%Live Voting:\%/color\% Votes during a meeting are immediately shown after a vote is cast.\%nl\%• \%color=#FF412F\%Merry Go Round:\%/color\% Each round roles in every team are shuffled. This excludes neutrals.\%nl\%• \%color=#7F7F7F\%No Skip:\%/color\% Meetings cannot be skipped.\%nl\%• \%color=#298B58\%Perfect Crew:\%/color\% When a crewmate is either ejected or executed by another crew member, all crewmates die alongside them.\%nl\%• \%color=#112E6E\%Tactical Deployment:\%/color\% Every round players can choose where they want to spawn on the map, similary to Airship's selection.\%nl\%• \%color=#42ECFF\%VIP:\%/color\% One crew player becomes the VIP, all crewmates need to protect them at all cost. If the VIP gets murdered, the killer's team wins the game. If the VIP is voted out or executed by another crew member, all crewmates die. Some roles and modifiers like Sheriff, Egotist and Lovers cannot be the VIP.
